- Date: 2026-04-30  
  Link: [TechCrunch — Stripe introduces Link, a digital wallet that autonomous AI agents can use](https://techcrunch.com/2026/04/30/stripe-link-digital-wallet-ai-agents-shopping/)

## 9. Podcast Highlights
- Date: 2026-05-01  
  Link: [YouTube — How Harness-as-a-Service Will Change Agents](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jvqQ8VlhO-w)  
  Summary: AI Daily Brief focused on “harness-as-a-service”: managed execution environments for agents, including hosted runtimes, sandboxed tool use, coding agents, IT triage, and workflow automation.  
  Available now: Partly. Managed agent runtimes and coding-agent infrastructure are already shipping across major AI developer platforms, but the podcast item provided no primary reference list.  
  How to use it: Identify a repeatable workflow, put the agent in a constrained runtime, expose only required tools, log actions, gate risky operations behind approval, and benchmark the full harness rather than the model alone.  
  Why it matters: Agent performance is increasingly determined by the surrounding execution harness: tools, state, permissions, sandboxes, evals, and recovery loops, not just model weights.
